category_description: Industry sector solutions, operational environments, and verified customer references served by New India Electricals Limited.

sectors.overview: Comprehensive electrical drive, power transformation, and distribution packages engineered for severe mechanical vibration, heat, and cyclical shock loads in steelmaking.
supplied_equipment: High-voltage AC and DC Mill Main Drives up to 10 MW
DC Mill Stand Motors up to 1 MW
Roller Table Direct Drive Motors with high thermal resistance
Flying Shear and Runout Table Motors
Electric Arc Furnace and Submerged Arc Furnace Transformers
Medium Voltage Vacuum Switchgear Panels (Power+ V)

sectors.overview: Explosion-proof, flameproof, and high starting torque power packages for open-cast and underground mineral extraction.
supplied_equipment: Flameproof Motors (Gas Groups I, IIA, IIB) for conveyors and pumps
Wound Rotor Slipring Motors for heavy ball mills and SAG mills
Horizontal Multistage RKB Pumps and Self-Priming Non-Clog Pumps for mine dewatering
Containerised Secondary Substations (CSS) for quick outdoor deployment

sectors.overview: High-efficiency continuous S1 duty motors, heavy gearboxes, and captive substation solutions operating in dusty, high-ambient environments.
supplied_equipment: High-voltage Cage and Slipring Motors for clinker raw mills and ball mills
Cycloidal Drives and Helical Shaft Mounted Reducers for heavy bucket elevators and conveyors
Distribution & Power Transformers
Medium Voltage Switchgear Panels

sectors.overview: Grid transmission and distribution equipment for regional and national electricity boards.
supplied_equipment: Distribution Transformers (11kV, 22kV, 33kV)
Power Transformers up to 111kV with on-load tap changers
Turnkey outdoor switchyards and substations up to 400kV
Outdoor Kiosk Circuit Breakers (Power+ VO & FO)

sectors.overview: Continuous utility pumping, turbine-driven mill motors, and automated motor control centers.
supplied_equipment: AC Mill Duty Motors and Slipring Motors
Stainless Steel Multistage Boiler Feed Pumps (IL Series)
Liquid Ring Vacuum Pumps (KV/DV Series) for evaporation and distillation
PCC and MCC Motor Control Center Panels
